verdict.rationale: Luma documents a Dream Machine API for video generation, with a generation endpoint, Python/JS/TS SDKs, API keys from the platform dashboard, and per-video credit pricing. Text-to-video, image-to-video and video-to-video modes plus keyframe control are exposed at the API, and EXR export implies the finished asset can be delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the job lifecycle (status polling or callback, asset download URL), a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404 on all candidate paths), and independent hands-on corroboration of the submit-and-retrieve flow.
